crossRefs.note: Whenever he brings out his own sheep, he goes before them, and the sheep follow him, for they know his voice.
I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep.
He who is a hired hand, and not a shepherd, who doesn’t own the sheep, sees the wolf coming, leaves the sheep, and…
even as the Father knows me, and I know the Father. I lay down my life for the sheep.
He lifted up his eyes and looked, and saw that three men stood near him. When he saw them, he ran to meet them from the…
Joseph was the governor over the land. It was he who sold to all the people of the land. Joseph’s brothers came, and…
When Joseph came home, they brought him the present which was in their hand into the house, and bowed themselves down…
Do this now, my son, and deliver yourself, since you have come into the hand of your neighbor. Go, humble yourself.…
If the spirit of the ruler rises up against you, don’t leave your place; for gentleness lays great offenses to rest.
For everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, and whoever humbles himself will be exalted.”
Those who were full have hired themselves out for bread. Those who were hungry are satisfied. Yes, the barren has borne…

translations.web: He himself passed over in front of them, and bowed himself to the ground seven times, until he came near to his brother.
translations.bsb: But Jacob himself went on ahead and bowed to the ground seven times as he approached his brother.
translations.kjv: And he passed over before them, and bowed himself to the ground seven times, until he came near to his brother.
translations.asv: And he himself passed over before them, and bowed himself to the ground seven times, until he came near to his brother.
